$provenance: Generated by Phase 2.4 of the desktop->web transition from the Qt sources named in 'generated_from', at commit 4bd0dc5, before sub-step 2.5 deleted them. Regenerate only by editing this file: the sources no longer exist.
note: Severity is carried by a *finding* (A11yFinding.severity), not by a rule; the vocabulary is exported here so a web checker can reuse it. 'check_function' names the Qt implementation that was deleted -- it is a pointer for whoever reimplements the rule against the DOM, not callable.

rules.description: Every button-like control has visible text or an accessible name.
Every QLineEdit/QComboBox/QAbstractSpinBox/QAbstractSlider has a buddy label or an accessible name.
Every non-empty QDialog has at least one keyboard-focusable widget.
No window-or-wider-scoped keyboard shortcut is bound twice.
Every QDockWidget has a non-empty window title.
Every pixmap-only QLabel has an accessible name or description.
The keyboard focus chain is not structurally degenerate.
